items.title: NetApp Unveils Novus, AI Data Engine Upgrades to Power Agentic AI
items.summary: NetApp (NASDAQ:NTAP) used its INSIGHT 2026 event to outline a strategy for helping enterprises prepare data infrastructure for agentic AI, announcing expanded cloud partnerships, enhancements to its AI Data Engine and management platform, and a new high-scale storage architecture called NetApp Novus

items.title: NetApp's Keystone Sovereign Targets Europe's Regulated Data Market
items.summary: NTAP's Keystone Sovereign expands regional, operational and data-handling controls as European customers seek greater infrastructure sovereignty.

items.title: NetApp’s AI Opportunity Can Support Higher Growth, Says BofA — Raises Target After INSIGHT Event
items.summary: According to TheFly, BofA lifted its NetApp price target after attending INSIGHT 2026, assigning a higher valuation multiple to the additional addressable market it sees emerging from artificial intelligence.

items.title: How are NTAP's New Partnerships Expanding Its AI Strategy?
items.summary: NetApp expands its cloud and AI infrastructure ecosystem through new collaborations with Oracle, SAP and Supermicro.

items.title: SAP (XTRA:SAP) Expands Cloud Infrastructure Partnership
items.summary: SAP (XTRA:SAP) and NetApp announced an expanded partnership focused on deeper cloud native integration into SAP Cloud Infrastructure. The collaboration aims to strengthen security, resilience, and performance for SAP and customer workloads running on SAP Cloud Infrastructure. Both companies plan to explore joint go to market initiatives and assess new technology integrations within SAP Cloud Infrastructure services.
